name: gitlab-mcp
description: Adds zereight/gitlab-mcp for GitLab projects, repositories, issues, merge requests, and pipelines on gitlab.com or a self-managed instance, in read-only permission mode. Needs a GitLab personal access token. From 2026.10.25 it replaces the archived reference GitLab server, which could also create issues, merge requests and commits; Ave asks for the token again and passes it as GITLAB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN.
